lost.source: No title-change document survives.

title: owa-online-internet-championship
label: Colt

how: Lost the deciding fall to a sunset flip reversal.

title: owa-online-internet-championship
label: Ricky Blood

title: owa-online-owa-tag-team-championship

title: owa-online-owa-tag-team-championship

won.source: Won the OWA Tag Team Championship from FireFly and Exterminator at WinterTime Massacre.

lost.source: No title-change document survives.

how: Won the title, undocumented, from Executioner at Holiday In Hell, 22 December 1996 (per the card's own advance billing).
